sources.title: PwC Mongolia, Tax and legal alert No. 03/2022: Labour Migration Law effective from 01 July 2022
sources.said: an employer is entitled to request a permit to invite a foreign employee if the employer assumes that there is no suitable local candidate after 14 working days of posting a job advertisement in the employment registry database for recruitment. … Labour Authority issues a permit to invite a foreign employee, to the employer, for a period of 3 months if there is no grounds for rejection. … Employers are required to submit an application for a work permit of a foreign employee on behalf of the employee to the Labour Authority after they are permitted to invite the foreign employee. The Labour Authority issues a work permit to the foreign employee for up to a year subject to the job position and term of the employment agreement. … A work permit granted to a foreign employee can be extended subject to applicable regulations.

sources.title: Law on Labour Migration (revised), 24 December 2021, art. 32 (State Great Khural, parliament.mn)
sources.said: МОНГОЛ УЛСЫН ХУУЛЬ … АЖИЛЛАХ ХҮЧНИЙ ШИЛЖИЛТ … 32 дугаар зүйл.Гадаад ажилтны ажлын байрны төлбөр … 32.1.Хуульд өөрөөр заагаагүй бол гадаад ажилтны ажлын байрны төлбөрийн нэг сарын хэмжээ нь нэг сард ногдох хөдөлмөрийн хөлсний доод хэмжээг 2 дахин нэмэгдүүлсэнтэй тэнцэх хэмжээтэй байна. … 32.5.Ажил олгогч хөдөлмөр эрхлэх гадаад ажилтны тоо, хугацаагаар тооцож ажлын байрны төлбөрийг урьдчилан төлнө.

sources.title: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection, 'Minimum Wage Increase in Mongolia' (7 October 2024)
sources.said: The National Tripartite Committee for Labour and Social Partnership convened on October 7, 2024, and reached a decision to raise Mongolia ’s minimum wage by 20%. The minimum wage will increase from 660,000 MNT to 792,000 MNT, effective Apr il 1, 2025.

note: Labour Migration Law (in force 1 July 2022), read through PwC Mongolia's alert since legalinfo.mn refuses this client: two steps, the employer's permit to invite a foreign employee (3 months, extendable once by 3), then the work permit the employer requests on the employee's behalf from the General Agency for Labour and Social Welfare Services, up to one year, extendable. For executive and assistant positions the employer must first advertise for 14 working days in the employment registry. Which category a performer falls into is not stated; the law's own list was not read. The workplace (job-place) fee employers pay for foreign workers was not found in a readable source. The workplace fee is the Labour Migration Law's (art. 32.1), twice the monthly minimum wage, paid ahead for the number of foreign employees and months (art. 32.5); art. 32.3's exemption for culture organisations covers doctors, researchers, teachers and coaches, not performers. The minimum wage is MNT 792,000 from 1 April 2025 (Ministry of Labour); news reports a rise to MNT 1,000,000 from 1 January 2027, not read from a primary. No separate application fee was found.
